exposure: Intrapartum continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) values (mean glucose, time in target range (TIR), time above target range (TAR))
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) length of stay
cohort: Laboring individuals with pregestational or gestational diabetes at or beyond 34 weeks gestation.
finding: Intrapartum continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) time above target range (TAR) was associated with a higher rate of neonatal hypoglycemia, and neonates born to individuals with TAR >61% were more likely to require continuous positive airway pressure and had a higher cord c-peptide level.
